svg.text: RIC · THE PART THAT SITS IN YOUR EAR
The bud is not a comfort choice
It is an acoustic prescription. Every opening you see is deliberate.
First, find it on your own hearing aid
The bud is the soft tip at the end of the wire. It is the
only part that touches your ear canal.
fewer openings, more sound held in
named for how much sound they let out
Most airflow. Your own voice stays
Fully sealed. For the highest power
Do not swap your bud to stop a whistle.
It was matched to your hearing loss, not to your comfort.
On a sloping loss the vent is the point.
The opening is what lets you keep natural sound. It cannot be sealed.
Seal a vented bud and your own voice booms.
That is occlusion. You traded one problem for a worse one.
If a correct re-fit does not stop it, the answer is a Critical Gain Measurement. It takes 10 seconds.
